dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_sky_d: You climbed all this way, %1$s? Most of us arrived the other way.
We keep the Truth up here. It keeps better in thin air.
The old man at the hall sends us a few each year. They take a while to stop looking down.
Mind the edge, %1$s. We drift down. You would not.
Hungry? I never am, but the kitchen likes a guest.
Dawnborn, %1$s. My grandmother walked up after the sun and never found a reason to go back down.
We call ourselves halfway. High enough for the light, not high enough for the ring.
The glowing ones let us stay because we got here on our own feet. That counts with them.
Praise the sun! It's closer here. Some mornings you can nearly hear it.
Down below they think we're wizards. Mostly we mend the windmill.
item.jaymoskingdoms.sky_letter.0: "...the sail tore again. Send twine with the next skiff, and tell mother the light is good."
item.jaymoskingdoms.sky_letter.1: "...he asked to stay and the old man wrote it down. He still looks over the edge every morning."
item.jaymoskingdoms.sky_letter.2: "...do not lean on the east rail. That is how we lost the last three hats."
item.jaymoskingdoms.sky_letter.3: "...the oranges came in early. Nobody here is ever hungry, so come and eat them."
item.jaymoskingdoms.sky_letter.4: "...if this reaches the ground, whoever you are: it is not as far as it looks."
